title: RTX reports Q2 2026 results
excerpt: RTX reported Q2 sales of USD 24.7 billion, GAAP EPS of USD 1.57, operating cash flow of USD 3.5 billion, and raised adjusted 2026 EPS guidance to USD 7.10-7.25.
summary: The issuer release supports current quarterly sales, earnings, segment margins, backlog, operating cash flow, free cash flow, and full-year adjusted sales, EPS, and free-cash-flow guidance.
